therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Gut microbiome modulation through selective intestinal antibiotic activity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with stage I-III HER2 positive breast cancer receiving pertuzumab-based therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Reduction rate of >= Grade 2 abdominal toxicities including abdominal distension, abdominal pain, diarrhea, dyspepsia, stomach pain, and typhlitis

results.target_engagement_evidence: Microbiome analysis planned but specific results not reported
biomarker_changes: Mean PIGT score decreased from baseline 2.17 to cycle 1: 1.61, cycle 2: 1.83, cycle 3: 1.71, cycle 4: 1.5, cycle 5: 1.53
subgroup_findings: 7 patients had reduction in mean number of stools in rifaximin arm vs 0 in control
results.dose_information: Rifaximin given orally, specific dose not specified
